name: Understanding Risks and Building Resilience
intro: Once you have completed Course 1: Using Generative in Government, we recommend moving on to Course 2 in the Responsible AI for Public Professionals series called "Understanding Risks and Building Resilience" in which you will learn how to use GenAI responsibly by exploring its risks—from bias and privacy concerns to deepfakes and misinformation—and understanding the broader societal impacts of this powerful technology.
